project_type: Python FastAPI service with Pydantic models, async/await patterns
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests
build_command: No explicit build command required (Python interpreted language)
verification_instructions: Run pytest on the specific test file. For full verification, run pytest services/project-ai/tests/ to ensure no regressions.
environment_constraints: Python 3.11+ required. Tests run synchronously (no async DB required for unit tests).
contribution_requirements: Python code follows standard patterns. No specific linting mentioned in docs for Python services, but tests must pass.
key_patterns:
- Pydantic models in app/models/ with BaseModel and Field
- DataClasses for internal structures with @dataclass
- Exception raising for error conditions (not silent fallbacks)
- Validation functions return Tuple[bool, List[str]] (is_valid, errors)
- Test classes group related tests (TestClassName pattern)
- pytest fixtures for test data setup
directory_structure:
services/project-ai/
├── app/
│   ├── placement/         # Artifact policy and comparator logic
│   ├── intake/            # Manifest generation and canonical comparison
│   ├── agents/            # Agent handlers
│   └── models/            # Pydantic models and enums
└── tests/
    ├── unit/              # Unit tests (91 total test files)
    ├── integration/       # Integration tests
    └── certification/     # Certification gate tests
